verdict.rationale: Resend documents a Create Webhook API for registering endpoints that receive real-time notifications about email events. Webhooks can be managed from the API, SDKs, CLI and MCP server, and also cover inbound email, which suits programmatic and agent consumers. A hands-on community user confirms webhooks work, with logging. Missing for 10: an enumerated catalog of event types, and documentation of payload signing/verification and retry behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
